answer: To resist Sybil swarms, the network anchors identity in cryptographic attestation chains verified via zero-knowledge proofs. Operating like a digital quill signing verifiable credentials, each node proves unique hardware provenance without revealing identity. Joining requires progressive collateral staking where fees scale quadratically (O(N^2)) with pool size. This tide of exponential capital exhaustion turns the network into an oasis that economically starves replicated attackers.
